From 6af6be278e3ba2ffb6af5b796c89dfb3f5d9063e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 12:05:55 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] gpio: cdev: Avoid NULL dereference in linehandle_create()

In linehandle_create(), there is a statement like this:
  retain_and_null_ptr(lh);

Soon after, there is a debug printout that dereferences "lh", which
will crash things.

Avoid the crash by using handlereq.lines, which is the same value.

Fixes: da7e394bf58f ("gpio: convert linehandle_create() to FD_PREPARE()")
Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260215120555.v2.1.I77c3eb563271c21870379eefd16ebbc4e09635bb@changeid
Signed-off-by: Bartosz Golaszewski <bartosz.golaszewski@oss.qualcomm.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpio/gpiolib-cdev.c b/drivers/gpio/gpiolib-cdev.c
index 2adc3c070908..189127721e38 100644
--- a/drivers/gpio/gpiolib-cdev.c
+++ b/drivers/gpio/gpiolib-cdev.c
@@ -388,7 +388,7 @@ static int linehandle_create(struct gpio_device *gdev, void __user *ip)
 	fd_publish(fdf);
 
 	dev_dbg(&gdev->dev, "registered chardev handle for %d lines\n",
-		lh->num_descs);
+		handlereq.lines);
 
 	return 0;
 }
-- 
2.34.1

This patch fixes a NULL pointer dereference in the `linehandle_create()` function within the GPIO character device driver.

**Modifications:**

- **File:** `drivers/gpio/gpiolib-cdev.c`
  - **Line 391:** In the `dev_dbg()` call, replaced `lh->num_descs` with `handlereq.lines`.

**Relationship:**
The change is a single-line substitution that corrects a use-after-NULL bug. The variable `lh` is set to NULL by a previous call to `retain_and_null_ptr(lh)`, so accessing `lh->num_descs` would cause a crash. The field `handlereq.lines` holds the same value (the number of requested lines) and remains valid because it was copied from user space before the nullification. This ensures the debug message prints the correct number of lines without dereferencing a null pointer.
